author: Alt Shift X
title: Commission: realistic Kingsguard costume illustration
content:
I'm looking to commission an illustrator!
I need a digital illustration of the white "Kingsguard" costume seen in the below images.
It should be a full-body male figure standing in a neutral position, wearing the costume, including white gloves and a sheathed sword at the belt.
It doesn’t need a face – I’m gonna Photoshop various heads onto it to represent different Kingsguard characters.
It should be a digital illustration in a realistic style, so it will look good when combined with photos.
It should be at least 1080 pixels tall, with a transparent background. Ideally PSD with separate layers.
No AI please.
If you're interested, please DM with your rate, and examples of past work.

Contact: DM on X with rate and examples
